items.quote: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings
items.claim: A law defines various types of offerings (burnt, meat, sin, trespass, consecrations, and peace offerings)
items.object: burnt offering, meat offering, sin offering, trespass offering, consecrations, sacrifice of the peace offerings

items.quote: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel to offer oblations at Mount Sinai in the wilderness
